additional_info.subject: RE: Reducing charging after 80% SOC CRM:02023000552
additional_info.body:
Dear Jose Martin,
I have reviewed the charging session logs from 2025-03-19, 09:18:52 to 2025-03-19, 10:43:18. Based on the data, the charger is delivering power as expected according to the vehicle's demand. As the vehicle’s State of Charge (SOC) reached around 80%, the power demand from the EV naturally decreased. This is a normal behavior, as the Battery Management System (BMS) of the vehicle reduces the charging power once the SOC approaches 80% to prevent overcharging and protect the battery.
Charging is typically faster in the initial phase (from 0% to 80%), but as the SOC increases, the charging speed slows down to safeguard the battery's health and longevity.
In conclusion, the reduced power demand after 80% SOC is entirely normal and part of the charging process designed to ensure the long-term.
I have also updated the name of the main asset from "Ex Socar" to "Von Bergen SA, Domdidier."
Please let me know if you have any questions, or if we can proceed with closing the ticket.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vikas Khiladkar
